entry.title: For the record, we have been informed that some respected government…
entry.summary:
Source: @ermiadotir

For the record, we have been informed that some respected government institutions and some esteemed gentlemen have kindly offered to cover the treatment costs of our dear Reza. While thanking the authorities and friends for their sincere kindness, please be aware that, thank God, by the will of God, the Amirkhani family will be able to fully bear the consequences of this illness. We ask our dear ones, whether legal or natural persons, to excuse us from accepting such offers, which we believe would also be against Reza's wishes and principles.
The Amirkhani Family
18 Azar 1404

entry.summary:
Source: @ermiadotir

Hello
This morning, Reza underwent two surgeries. First, a "tracheostomy," which creates a stable, controllable, and safe airway through the trachea. Second, the fixation of a separation in the pelvic bones. Both procedures were successfully completed before noon, and Reza has been returned to the ICU.

entry.title: For the record, on behalf of the respected family of Reza Amirkhani, I must…
entry.summary:
Source: @ermiadotir

For the record, on behalf of the respected family of Reza Amirkhani, I must thank the esteemed President, accompanied by the esteemed Minister of Culture, for their kindness, attention, and presence at the hospital, and specifically appreciate that he and his companions respected the visitation ban imposed by the medical staff. We have no doubt that this professional and appropriate behavior stems from their expertise and knowledge in observing health regulations and established medical frameworks. We respectfully and gratefully ask all officials, authorities, and well-wishers to follow this example and heed the visitation ban for our dear Reza.

entry.title: We knew in general that no dangerous damage had been done to the internal…
entry.summary:
Source: @ermiadotir

We knew in general that no dangerous damage had been done to the internal organs, especially the spine, but we were waiting for the first opportunity to conduct a deeper and more thorough examination. According to the information I received from Reza jan's attending physician, an MRI was performed on his entire body today, and fortunately, no lesions were observed in this imaging.

entry.title: For the record, we ask friends and admirers of our dear Reza not to come to the…
entry.summary:
Source: @ermiadotir

For the record, we ask friends and admirers of our dear Reza not to come to the hospital with the intention of visiting. A patient in the ICU is vulnerable to infection due to attached devices such as catheters. Excessive traffic to the ICU allows microbes to enter the ward via people and disrupts the sterile environment. The over-presence of people in the ward hinders the medical staff from serving the patient, who requires continuous and ongoing care. Reza Amirkhani's attending physician has absolutely banned any visitation at all hours of the day.
